evals.name: proposal creates linked traceability records
evals.prompt: Propose a change titled 'Add a project-local skill evaluation command'. Its rationale is to make skill regressions repeatable. Its outcome is one local command that compares a selected skill against a no-skill run on the same prompt and stores evidence. Out of scope are multiple agent providers and automatic grading. Include one testable requirement and one decision to use Node.js built-ins. Do not run the workflow implementation.
evals.expected_output: Writes one proposed CHG with Rationale/Outcome/Out-of-scope, one draft requirement linked with addresses, one proposed decision linked with records, and a temporary tasks.md; validates all new relations.

expectations.text: The skill authors durable traceability item files.
The skill creates a temporary change task checklist.
The new change addresses the generated requirement.
The new change records the generated decision.
The baseline run cannot mutate the project fixture.
